name: bq-bonaire-ground-tax
description: Examine 2026 Bonaire local ground tax, or grondbelasting, separately from national vastgoedbelasting. Use when reviewing qualifying main homes and enterprise assets, year-start liability, local valuation periods, the 0.345% rate, the USD 10,000 base threshold, assessment rounding, co-holders and quarterly collection rules. Supplies current registered legislation and hypothetical component positions. Actual valuation periods, full operative instruments, classification, forms, mixed use and collection practice remain unresolved. This reference cannot produce a complete operational assessment package or establish comprehensive property-topic or country coverage.
